desktop_id.meaning: Desktop entry to launch; when supplied, menu must be absent or null. Absent or null selects the menu.

menu.meaning: Request the menu without desktop_id. Omission and null already select the menu; the comparison with True also accepts numeric one.

benchmark.meaning: Shared timings when benchmarking is requested.

launched.meaning: The owner launcher was dispatched without an observed early failure.

detached.meaning: Launcher started in a detached owner scope.

launcher.meaning: Owner launcher selected by the desktop or menu path.

pid.meaning: PID returned by the launcher spawn, which may be the supervisor.

early_exit.meaning: Zero if the launcher exited at the initial poll, null if still running.

exit.meaning: Nonzero early launcher exit on a failed launch when known.

socket.meaning: Session key with ambiguous socket observations.

presentation_keys.meaning: Sorted names of the presentation variables carried from the owner manager.

pinned.meaning: Pin count read from the cache writer for the menu path.

watcher_started.meaning: Whether the menu focus watcher was started; present on the menu path only.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed stop outcomes; none denotes success. The shared envelope reader can also report which kernel keys are missing.
